cohort: 88 women with preeclampsia (PE) and 60 age- and BMI-matched normotensive women
finding: Increased sFlt-1 levels and the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio were independently associated with an increased risk of PE, while PlGF levels were not.
mod_finding: Increased sFlt-1 levels and sFlt-1/PlGF ratio were significantly correlated with C-section.
